FeedbackText: The lectures were clear and engaging. I enjoyed the coding assignments.
Assignments were too long, but office hours were extremely helpful.
Great course overall! The exams were fair and reflected class material.
The textbook was hard to understand, but professor explained concepts well.
More practice problems would be helpful for exam preparation.
Loved the group discussions and reading selections. Great feedback on essays!
Grading rubric for essays was unclear. Would appreciate more detailed feedback.
Lab experiments were exciting and helped reinforce theoretical concepts.
The pace of lectures was too fast during the second half of the semester.
Project deadlines overlapped with other major courses. Better scheduling needed.
